column3: For every n>=2 and every finite group with the same order and degree pattern, require isomorphism to L_n(2). Degree pattern/prime graph construction is not explicitly specified. Recognition for n=10,11 does not supply a uniform all-rank mechanism; park.

For every stable coherent system with R=2rank(F)>0 require the displayed slope bound. mu' stability and exact constants c,b are absent; decimal 1.3818 is not an exact replacement. Cannot formulate the literal endpoint.

For both ADE constructions require the identically zero genus-two G-function. The decomposition does not define Q_p,c_p or G independently. Checking a few ADE types would not prove both unbounded families; no short uniform cancellation identified.

The placement of 'for all n' relative to iff is unclear and pattern lengths/classes are unrestricted. Binary-tree spine refinement is not defined. For small n both counts vanish, so a pointwise-iff reading is suspect; do not credit this wording objection.

For six stated weights and all positive n demand nonzero normalized newform coefficients. The Sato-Tate metadata assertion does not imply pointwise nonvanishing. Multiplicativity reduces to prime powers but leaves the hard prime coefficient obstruction; no full-scope route.

Limit over all square sizes requires a specified firefighter budget, move order and optimal saving policy. rho is described informally without those rules. Finite grid optimization cannot establish the exact limit; retain HOLD.

For every k>=0 demand divisibility by12 of the explicitly defined restricted partition count. Source v1 Conjecture1 matches; modular3 alone is insufficient, and a uniform mod4 dissection is the missing bridge. Finite checks are diagnostics only; successor/prior HOLD.

For every n>=0 demand divisibility by40 of the defined overpartition count. Literal itself says the source proves this, conflicting with metadata. Source-reported known-result objection bars promotion pending body confirmation; no new proof claimed.

All root systems and discriminants refer to an absent table and undefined K-module; 'D != -27 lambda^2 for some integer lambda' differs from for every lambda. No exact quantified full target recoverable from this literal.

For all n>=1 require existence to force omega_U=1, and for all n>=4 require nonexistence. Fusion category construction and parameter domain are source-specific and absent. Extending computations through10 is not a full-scope obstruction.

For every parameter pair outside equation(exc) assert K_4,36 nonzero. Hamiltonian, cycle constituents, transported jet, and exceptional locus are absent. Cannot reproduce the quantity or excluded parameters; no replacements.

For every k>=4 require floor(k/2)-1 relations. Generating set and qMZ construction are not defined; relation dimension depends on that presentation. A finite rank computation to20 would not prove all weights.

For each positive n and every n-term consecutive interval strictly between n^2 and(n+1)^2 require a prime. This is a strong uniform short-interval assertion; bounded primality computations cannot resolve arbitrary n. No tractable deterministic mechanism.

Literal explicitly defines cycle-maximal as edge-saturated, then claims precisely balanced complete bipartite graphs for all n. Source defines cycle-maximal by a global maximum cycle count. C5 refutes the literal definition but is only a wording correction; source question not resolved.

For every n>=1 compare descent distribution on signed doubled multisets to ascents of length2n s-inversion sequences. Signed descent convention and scaled ascent definition are not supplied. A few distributions are instances; no all-n bijection or generating recurrence derived.

The two inequalities quantify a,b,n1,n2 but lack admissible parameter range and winning-coalition definition. Relative Banzhaf denominators can degenerate on boundary cases. Cannot screen strictness uniformly until the game model is restored.

For odd-part partitions of a common size require equivalence of class order with reversed dominance. The twisted class order and twist are absent; ordinary symmetric-group classes alone do not define it. No source-independent monotonicity argument.

For every order bound and every indicated partition interval pair require the stretching length comparison. LGL derivative roots define the usual grids. Interlacing alone does not compare these stretched adjacent lengths uniformly; no exact all-order certificate found.

Demand both quotient monotonicities at all orders, but first clause only says fixed k/relevant indices and omits its valid endpoints. Root interlacing is weaker than ratio monotonicity. No finite sweep would discharge the all-order claims.

Exists C(t) for every r>=C demand Ex_r=rn, but t_i domains, k,n restrictions and definition of Ex_r/sparsity are absent. For unrestricted k the assertion may change. Restore full sequence model before proof work.

For all unicyclic orders outside the listed cycle cases assert P_n^6 maximizes energy; small n<6 construction also needs attention. Literal says source completely solves the family. Treat as source-reported prior/endpoint issue, no eligible new result inferred.

For all primes p>=3 and p all respectively, and implicit m>=1, demand the two congruences. m is not explicitly bound. Primary Theorems1.2/1.3 cover p>=5 and all p for s18; remaining p=3 for s7 lacks an all-m bridge. No credit for proved subfamilies.

For every complete Riemannian plane, unique disjoint geodesic through each exterior point should force flatness. The condition is global; local curvature or a special metric family is insufficient. No bounded full-plane rigidity mechanism identified.

For each theta>=0 with matched kappa require distributional convergence as n grows. Infinite triangulation law T_kappa and local topology are not defined. Euler degree matching is necessary but does not establish tightness or identification.

For every complete interpolating sequence require a positive constant uniform in omega and N. The dual functions phi_k are not defined and constant dependence needs source confirmation. A Dirichlet-kernel special case does not control arbitrary Riesz sampling systems.

All g,h coefficients obey one formal product, but the BPS count construction/divisibility conventions are not specified. Formal coefficient expansion computes the prediction rather than identifies the enumerative invariants. Large geometric dependency chain; park.

For every dimension and normed real space require Liouville volume>=4^n/n!. Unit balls make the symmetric volume product precise. Low-dimensional polytopes or cube equality are instances; no sharp arbitrary-dimensional inequality route.

For every n>1 and each of seven explicit triples require integer sum divisible by n binom(2n,n). Exact hypergeometric sums make finite checking possible but seven all-n divisibilities need uniform certificates. No creative-telescoping certificate established.

For every I>=8 require I disjoint(I+2)-element Golomb rulers packing the entire interval of size I(I+2). Counting supplies lower bound only; all-I packing needs a uniform construction. Finite library through150 supplies no such construction.

Universal positive infimum across all nonzero-length metrized graphs uses the undefined tau functional. The additional strict1/108 claim is stronger than positivity and must not replace it. No uniform energy lower-bound proof identified.

For each epsilon>0 demand uniform nonsquare-D cancellation in the given growth range plus the D=0 asymptotic. The two claims need different analyses; elementary absolute bounds lose cancellation. No complete analytic continuation/spectral mechanism supplied.

All finite characteristically simple groups are included, including abelian C_p^k and small groups. Beauville property is undefined and standard small abelian exceptions make the iff suspect as written. Domain correction is uncredited; no nonabelian all-family proof route.

For each r>=0 classify all positive integer pairs with gap2^r and cube-full product. Obvious powers of2 give the asserted family, but do not exclude odd prime factors. Cube-full consecutive number constraints obstruct a short all-size classification.

Infinitely many primes must have no cube-full gap representation, and29 must be least. Even checking one fixed prime requires excluding unbounded A,B. Bounded searches do not certify nonexistence or infinitude; no full route.

Exists universal C for every k and every strongly Ck-connected tournament ensuring all ordered disjoint k-pair linkages. Exhaustive small tournaments cannot settle linear connectivity. Path routing requires a substantial uniform combinatorial theorem; no small certificate route.

For every separated set in R3 and every unit-distance pair with both kissing degrees12 require at least4 common neighbors. Although local, it is a continuous configuration problem with24 incident positions. No exact feasible fewer-than4 construction or exhaustive geometric obstruction identified.

For all knots and each of15 named Rig quandles require endpoint color equality. Finite operation tables are not present; all-knot extension would require a faithful embedding or extension theorem verified for those tables. Finite crossing data is not full scope.

For every knot require invariant support in even powers of Z4. The generating cocycle is selected by source example but absent. Reduction modulo2 might use a coboundary certificate, but no exact cocycle table available; no claimed certificate.

For every knot require no u or u5 terms of Z6 invariant. Specific cocycle and table absent. Unlike subgroup support, allowed exponents2,3,4 are not closed under addition; a naive closure/connected-sum argument needs actual realization data. HOLD.

For every n>=12 and admitted k demand exact graph equality iff odd n,k=n-1,n-4 composite. Prime graph adjacency is conventional but not specified. Source flags additive prime obstructions; checking cycle types gives a prime-sum condition rather than an all-n resolution.

For all n>=2 and x in C_n require D(x)>=1, but neither configuration domain nor determinant normalization is defined. The n=2 example cannot select among inequivalent Atiyah-Sutcliffe analogues. Missing target, no replacement.

All tensor models and disclination lines are claimed, but corrupted7k/2 and71/2 notation, stability ordering and admissible models are undefined. Special disk result does not restore universal target. No technical endpoint available.

For all parallel alternations of length>=6 require Av(pi) deflatable. Deflatability and the exact parallel-alternation convention are absent. Individual witnesses do not yield a uniform witness for every length/orientation; no proved mechanism.

For all integer n>=0 require each of five displayed Young graphs isomorphic to Y(11,7). Graph transition/retained-vertex definitions are absent. Affine carry-state templates could be a route only after definition and successor verification; not yet a justified hypothesis.

For every alpha>0 exists beta>0 and a sufficiently large threshold uniform over all sets of size>p^alpha. Square-root character-sum bounds address only larger sets; small positive alpha needs genuine pseudorandom cancellation. No complete route.

For each admissible nonempty peak set require all complex roots within radius m and real part>=-3. Peak polynomial/admissibility are not defined here. Finite numerical roots do not certify all sets; no universal coefficient/root-location mechanism derived.

For all n>=10 congruent1 mod3 require sdepth quotient=ceil(n/3). J_n is referenced rather than explicitly generated. Matching a general edge-ideal bound would require the exact ideal and sharp Stanley decomposition; no uniform construction established.
